text: {"labels": [{"claim_id": "c1", "label": "C", "reason": "Passage 0 forbids reuse for Authorization requests unless a Cache-Control directive allows it; freshness alone is not the stated condition."}, {"claim_id": "c5", "label": "C", "reason": "Passage 7 says the status code SHOULD be 504, not 502, so the number is wrong."}, {"claim_id": "c3", "label": "C", "reason": "Passage 2 requires the most recent response, not the oldest."}, {"claim_id": "c7", "label": "C", "reason": "Passage 5 says a cache MUST NOT invalidate when the origin differs, so this permission is denied."}, {"claim_id": "c4", "label": "C", "reason": "Passage 7 says must-revalidate must never be ignored; a disconnected cache must error rather than reuse stale."}]}
